summary: Busy parked-up residential kerb with flats and houses 20 m away all round.
reasons: Homes within about 20 m all round

best_section.where: North kerb of Vincent Street, mid-block between the two flat blocks

drivers.seclusion: Nearest dwellings about 20 m (flats at 87 m and 108 m); more flats and houses all round, with a house 11 m back at 84 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked on both kerbs; room to pull in.
drivers.convention: Many cars parked along both kerbs, so a van blends in.

flags: Dense flats and houses on both sides
Steeper near the west end (about 5% at 20-40 m)
Police station about 30 m from the west end
sun_shade: Partly shaded by street and garden trees; open to sun from the north over the flats.
